why_partial_recovery_does_not_close_this: The snapshot id is a single digest over all 202 normalized texts at once. Reproducing 63 of them certifies those 63 documents individually and says nothing about the collective fingerprint. Recovering the evidence excerpts behind any set of GOLD cases does not reproduce the corpus.

B. the intended snapshot is fully reconstructed and revalidated to snap_689e336380a054d8039dc35b2c09cd0a
